metadata.case_name: MUHAMMAD RIAZ KHAN v. COMMISSIONER OF CORRECTIONAL SERVICES

source: At QMH, the plaintiff was found to have a fracture of left nasal bone.

injuries.description: Neck injury (soft tissue / acute neck injury)
source: The plaintiff sustained a fracture of the nasal bone, internal and external bleeding of the nose and neck injury.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level, unspecified

injuries.description: Cervical spondylosis (degenerative disorder for the cervical spine)
source: he had received treatment at QMH and was diagnosed as having cervical spondylosis (ie degenerative disorder for the cervical spine).

injuries.description: Frozen shoulder (typical symptoms of frozen shoulder)
source: at the time of the joint medical examination on 25 November 2014, the plaintiff was suffering from typical symptoms of “frozen shoulder”
injuries.icd_description: Injury of muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: Superficial abrasions, bruises and redness to face, arms, chest and forehead
injuries.body_part: face, left shoulder, chest, left mid-arm, right mid-arm, left forehead
source: Both eyes redness, visual acuity intact;
Patch of redness over left shoulder (posterior aspect), size 4cm x 3cm;
Patch of redness over anterior chest, size 3cm x 3cm;
Left mid-arm region, patch of bruise and redness, superficial abrasion, size 3cm x 3cm;
Patch of circular area of redness over right mid-arm, size 3cm x 3cm; and
Linear superficial redness over left forehead region.

injuries.description: Chronic allergic rhinitis (pre-existing chronic nasal blockage)
source: he had had symptoms of chronic nasal blockage and was treated in QMH since 2002 which preceded the October 3 incident.

manifestations.description: Both eyes redness, visual acuity intact
Patch of redness over left shoulder (posterior aspect), size 4cm x 3cm
Patch of redness over anterior chest, size 3cm x 3cm
Left mid-arm region, patch of bruise and redness, superficial abrasion, size 3cm x 3cm
Patch of circular area of redness over right mid-arm, size 3cm x 3cm
Linear superficial redness over left forehead region
Nasal stuffiness and difficulty in breathing whenever he lied down
Neck pain with radiation to the left trapezius region and upper back associated with remarkable neck stiffness
Left shoulder pain associated with significant stiffness
Left arm weakness and numbness (history since 2005)

treatments_received.treatment: Admission to Queen Mary Hospital for treatment
source: He was admitted to Queen Mary Hospital (“QMH”) for treatment.
He was given a neck collar for the support of his neck.
X-ray examination found no bony lesion in his left shoulder.

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenity
